,f.id as f_id,f.name as f_name,f.file_url as f_file_url,f.save_type as f_save_type ,f2.id as f2_id,f2.name as f2_name,f2.file_url as f2_file_url,f2.save_type as f2_save_type ,a.activate_size,a.id,a.type,a.master_id,a.ret_id,a.video_id
left join sys_file f on m.logo_id=f.id left join sys_file f2 on m.intro_video_id=f2.id left join gc_master_active a on a.master_id=m.id
left join gc_subject gcSubject on m.id = gcSubject.master_id

, gcSubject.id AS "gcSubject.id", gcSubject.name AS "gcSubject.name", gcSubject.description AS "gcSubject.description", gcSubject.type AS "gcSubject.type", gcSubject.sub_img_id AS "gcSubject.subImgId", gcSubject.is_public AS "gcSubject.isPublic"
mapper.select:
SELECT m.*, ma.username AS managerUsername, a.maxLoginTime , a.masterId as masterId, a.maxLoginTime as userLastLoginTime FROM gc_master m LEFT JOIN gc_manager ma ON ma.id = m.manager_id LEFT JOIN (select access.master_id as masterId, MAX(ext.log_in_time) as maxLoginTime from gc_user_access_ext ext LEFT JOIN gc_user_access access on access.id = ext.user_access_id GROUP BY access.master_id )a on a.masterId=m.id WHERE 1 = 1 AND m.context IS NOT NULL
and concat(m.context,',',m.org_name) like concat('%',#{searchFilter},'%')
GROUP BY m.id
